messages.subject: Multilevel SEM and categorical variables
parts:
I would like to estimate a Multilevel SEM with observed (manifest) binary and ordinal variables. Is it possible to perform this type of analysis with lavaan?

Thank you!
Silvia

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multilevel SEM and categorical variables
parts: Is it possible to perform this type of analysis with lavaan?

No, lavaan can currently only estimate MSEMs with continuous, complete data.
